title: Microsoft Purview: bulk replacement or removal of retention labels (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing retention, permissions and audit controls are supported. It distinguishes the planned bulk action from documented item-level operations and correctly leaves its default, specific licensing and operational details open.

claims.claim: A regulatory record label cannot be manually changed.

claims.claim: A regulatory record label cannot be manually removed.
claims.quote: The most important difference for a regulatory record is that after it is applied to content, nobody, not even a global administrator, can remove the label.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: How the bulk action handles record and regulatory record labels is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview bulk replacement removal retention label role permissions restricted administrators records regulatory scheduling approval undo preview audit. Opened retention and records-management; these describe existing record restrictions, not the planned bulk action.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Retention labels set retention settings and periods for individual content items.
claims.quote: In all these cases, retention labels let you apply retention settings for governance control at the item level (document or email).

claims.claim: Retention labels can specify when content is deleted.
claims.quote: Press materials that need to be permanently deleted when they reach a specific age. Competitive research that needs to be retained for a specific period and then permanently deleted.

claims.claim: Removing a retention label from a single driveItem clears the label and all its associated retention settings.
claims.quote: Remove the retention label from a driveItem. This operation clears the retention label and all associated retention settings enforced on the item.

claims.claim: DELETE /v1.0/drives/{drive-id}/items/{item-id}/retentionLabel removes a label from one SharePoint or OneDrive item, not a bulk selection.
claims.quote:
DELETE /drives/{drive-id}/items/{item-id}/retentionLabel
In SharePoint Online and OneDrive, removal of a Record retention label isn't supported when using app-only authentication. This operation requires a delegated user context.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify individual workload locations beyond tenant-wide or targeted content.
claims.quote: They can perform the action across the entire tenant or targeted to specific content using KQL and static or adaptive scopes.

claims.quote: Alternatively to using this default role, you can create a new role group and add the Retention Management role to this group. For a read-only role, use View-Only Retention Management.
